goal: Migrate eTMF frontend, API gateway, and AI processing service to target enterprise architecture: Next.js (App Router), Go API Gateway, and Python/FastAPI AI Service
decisions: Monorepo structure with services/ai-service (Python/FastAPI) and services/api-gateway (Go 1.24)
Next.js App Router for frontend with full backwards compatibility for all 10 clinical consoles
Go API Gateway implementing 21 CFR Part 11 headers, JWT auth, document routes, and delegating to FastAPI AI service
Python AI Service implementing Gemini 1.5 Flash client with exact DIA v3.2 schema, Condition A/B/C routing, and clinical NLP fallback
first_three_tasks: 1.1 Build Python FastAPI AI Service in services/ai-service/
2.1 Build Go API Gateway in services/api-gateway/
3.1 Configure Next.js App Router in frontend/ and verify build
